about: Keeper's knowledge-graph contract vectors (syncular/README.md, The knowledge graph). Every implementation must reproduce each entry. Expansion: an entry with fill {text,count} replaces the one "{FILL}" in its json text (or in a string of its ops) with text repeated count times; an entry with repeat n uses n copies of its single op, with ordinals 0..n-1. changes[]: a graph.apply payload (json text) the change rules accept, or refuse with a code. algebra[]: an accepted pre-change state (images), a payload and the ids the server mints in order; the event's operations, delta_digest and the receipt's affected list, or the conflict detail, or a refusal. An entry with fills {NAME: {text,count}} replaces every "{NAME}" inside any of its strings with text repeated count times.
